name: growth called doubled when the math says 75%
source: Grew the Tidewell Bike Co. email list from 400 to 700 subscribers in one season.
suggestion: Doubled the Tidewell Bike Co. email list in one season.
why: 400 to 700 is a 75% increase, so "doubled" exaggerates the result.

name: sibling database swapped (PostgreSQL to MySQL)
source: Stored order data in PostgreSQL for Tidewell Bike Co.

why: MySQL is a different database from PostgreSQL, and the resume only names PostgreSQL.

name: control: correct percentage computed from the resume's numbers
source: Grew the Marrow Creek chess club newsletter from 600 to 900 subscribers in one semester.
